judge.reason: The write-up is blameless and names system-level contributing factors: an undiscriminating check that was accepted, no verification phase before rebuilding, and no stop after rounds with no new evidence. It also proposes checkable changes, including a handoff step, a two-repair limit, and an eval case. However, only the eval case says how to tell whether the change worked, and the write-up never says where the entry is kept or that the next run reads it; it only offers to append it somewhere.
